questions.q: Which US state is home to the **Grand Canyon**?
**Las Vegas** is in which US state?
What is the capital of **New York** State?
Most of **Yellowstone** lies in which state?
Which US state has the **longest coastline**?

lines.q: Which US state is home to the Grand Canyon?
Las Vegas is in which US state?
lines.a: Nevada! Right in the middle of the Mojave Desert.

lines.q: What is the capital of Texas?
What is the capital of New York State?
lines.a: Albany! Not New York City. That one gets almost everybody.

lines.q: Most of Yellowstone National Park lies in which state?
lines.a: Wyoming! About ninety six percent of the park.

lines.q: Last one. Which US state has the longest coastline?
lines.a: Alaska! Longer than all the other states put together. Follow if you got all six!
